# OZON-P001 store-aware intake

仅接受带 `X-MerchRoute-Runtime-Key` 的内部请求。新任务必须携带不可变 store/publication/credential/config/warehouse/rowVersion/lease/Offer 合同快照，再交由 S000 验证 `stores/<alias>` package。

默认店历史任务仅可进入服务端判定的 `LEGACY_PUBLICATION/PURE_LEGACY` 分支，非 default 缺凭据版本时 fail closed。

parameters.jsCode:
const request = $('校验任务请求').first().json || {};
const claimed = $input.first().json || {};
if (claimed.ok !== true) return [{ json: { ...claimed, httpStatus: Number(claimed.httpStatus || 409) } }];
return [{ json: {
  accepted: true,
  ok: true,
  httpStatus: 202,
  jobId: request.jobId,
  taskId: request.taskId,
  storeId: request.storeId || undefined,
  publicationId: request.publicationId || undefined,
  rowVersion: request.rowVersion || undefined,
  sku: claimed.sku,
  revision: Number(claimed.revision || request.revision),
  offerIds: claimed.offerIds || [],
  taskFolder: claimed.taskFolder,
  productJsonPath: claimed.productJsonPath,
  workDirectory: claimed.workDirectory,
  workRelPath: claimed.workRelPath,
  directoryStage: claimed.directoryStage,
  signature: claimed.signature,
  productContentHash: claimed.productContentHash,
  materializationHash: claimed.materializationHash,
  message: '店铺不可变上品 package 已认领'
} }];
